rationale: With 0 minutes to close any position entered will be immediately marked-to-market at the closing auction, eliminating any opportunity for a directional thesis to resolve. The final 1-minute candle printed a sharp 5-cent drop on the highest volume of the afternoon (48k shares) while sitting 67.8% up in the daily range and just below the 5-minute EMA, but this micro-distribution has no time to follow through before the forced liquidation. Flat SPY, quiet VIXY, and absence of news further remove any short-term edge.
